Class SuperTypeCollector

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.inject.ast.SuperTypeCollector
@Internal public final class SuperTypeCollector extends Object
Collects the super types of a type for ClassElement.getAllSuperTypes(): one walk of the hierarchy, each super type bound into the arguments of the type the walk starts from, the super types of a raw type erased, and a type reached again by another path neither listed nor walked again.

The walk asks a function for the direct super types of each type it reaches, so a language whose types can have several concrete bases, as Python's can, walks all of them where declared(ClassElement) walks the one super class and then the interfaces a ClassElement declares.

5.3.0

      @NonNull public static @NonNull List<ClassElement> collect(@NonNull @NonNull ClassElement type, @NonNull @NonNull Map<String, ClassElement> bindings, @NonNull @NonNull Function<ClassElement, Stream<ClassElement>> directSuperTypes, @NonNull @NonNull UnaryOperator<ClassElement> declaration)
      The type and its super types, as ClassElement.getAllSuperTypes() lists them, for a language that binds the variables of the type itself, or walks a super type, other than as the element answers.
      Parameters:
      type - The type
      bindings - What the variables of the type are bound to, by name: its own arguments, or its declared variables for a type whose arguments answer their bounds
      directSuperTypes - The direct super types of a type reached by the walk, as the language declares them, with their arguments written in the variables of that type
      declaration - The element to ask for the direct super types of a listed super type: the super type itself when its super types come back written in its own variables, or its declaration when a resolved variable of another language would lose the name they are bound by
      Returns:
      The type first, its super types, and Object last
